title: StudioIdempotencyHeaders
description: Header contract for mutating /api/v3/studio commands. The client generates one idempotency key per user intent and preserves it across network retry. Same key/same normalized request hash returns the original result; same key/different hash is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH. Mutations additionally require expected revision/version/hash.

Idempotency-Key.description: Client-generated key per user intent, stable across retries.

Expected-Version.description: Expected aggregate version for optimistic concurrency.

Expected-Hash.description: Expected content hash of the artifact being decided upon (e.g. exact candidate set hash, reviewed screenplay hash).
